## Run it live

The app below is the one above, running in your browser: [Shinylive](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/shinylive.html) runs R and Shiny with [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), so no server is involved. The first start downloads webR and the packages, which takes a little while; plotly.core comes from [its r-universe](https://msummersgill.r-universe.dev), which builds it for webR, hence the `webr::install()` line, which runs only in webR (`R.version$os == "emscripten"`), so the same code also runs as a normal Shiny app.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 520
# In the browser (webR), install plotly.core from its r-universe; elsewhere
# it's installed as usual, and this line is skipped
if (R.version$os == "emscripten") {
  webr::install("plotly.core", repos = c("https://msummersgill.r-universe.dev", "https://repo.r-wasm.org"))
}

library(shiny)
library(plotly.core)

window <- 60 # seconds shown
rate <- 10 # points per second
n <- window * rate # points kept per trace

# Times as plotly.js date strings (local time, with milliseconds)
stamp <- function(t) format(t, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS3")

ui <- fluidPage(plotlyOutput("stream"))

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$stream <- renderPlotly({
    t <- Sys.time() - seq(window, 0, length.out = n)
    go_figure() |>
      add_scatter(x = stamp(t), y = sin(as.numeric(t)), mode = "lines", name = "sin(t)") |>
      add_scatter(x = stamp(t), y = cos(as.numeric(t)), mode = "lines", name = "cos(t)") |>
      update_layout(yaxis_range = c(-1.1, 1.1))
  })

  proxy <- plotlyProxy("stream", session)

  observe({
    invalidateLater(1000 / rate)
    t <- Sys.time()
    s <- as.numeric(t)
    plotlyProxyInvoke(
      proxy,
      "extendTraces",
      list(x = list(I(stamp(t)), I(stamp(t))), y = list(I(sin(s)), I(cos(s)))),
      I(c(0L, 1L)),
      n
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

webR runs R in the browser tab, a few times slower than R on your computer, so a live app suits demonstrations rather than heavy computation. `save_image()` doesn't work there: webR can't start a browser.
